verdict.rationale: OpenCode is a terminal/IDE-based coding agent that takes natural-language queries (e.g. `opencode run "Explain how closures work..."`), can explore/read codebases via a dedicated read-only agent, and auto-loads LSPs so it can surface diagnostics/errors while chatting, all of which supports NL-driven debugging and troubleshooting; community users confirm using it as a daily 'harness' with good LSP integration for real work. missing for 10: no dedicated 'debug' or troubleshooting workflow docs, and community reports of failed tool calls/unreliable file edits with some models introduce real-world friction.
